notes.title: Do not explain the return before observing it
notes.body: The first return publication is a perturbation, not a conclusion. Do not publish a success interpretation from early views, likes or comments.

notes.title: Keep the Grimoire canonical
notes.body: Platform posts may disappear or be recoded. The Grimoire retains the lineage, state, missing fields and later return reading.

notes.title: Contradiction remains publishable
notes.body: A return that contradicts the working hypothesis remains useful. Do not visually punish a negative or indeterminate result.
